state.seed_assertion: Controllers must conduct a review to assess if processing complies with the data protection impact assessment when there is a change in the risk represented by processing operations.

sentences.1: Controllers must conduct a review to assess if processing complies with the data protection impact assessment when there is a change in the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.2: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.3: A controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.4: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.5: It is important to reevaluate the DPIA when there is a change of the risk represented by the processing operation.
sentences.6: A DPIA must be kept under review and may need to be repeated if there is a substantial change to the nature, scope, context, or purposes of processing.
sentences.7: A DPIA should be reevaluated when there is a change in the risk represented by the processing operation due to evolution of technology, use of data for different purposes, or organizational context changes.
sentences.8: DPIAs should be kept under review and revisited when necessary.
sentences.9: A schedule for regularly reviewing the DPIA or reviewing it when processing changes should be agreed and documented.
sentences.10: A DPIA should clearly state how the organization is complying with each of the Data Protection Principles under GDPR and explain the lawful basis for processing.
